# SciFiWriter.ca

> > A science fiction and fantasy writing resource site providing free tools, worldbuilding guides, and community support for speculative fiction authors.

Founded by Dave Stoyles in 2018, SciFiWriter.ca offers character name generators, writing craft articles, and worldbuilding resources tailored specifically for sci-fi and fantasy writers. The site emphasizes practical tools and community-driven content for authors at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Dave Stoyles
- NaNoWriMo
- Character name generators
- Worldbuilding
- Scrivener

- Speculative fiction
- Creative writing craft

## Getting Started

- [Sci-Fi Writer – Fantasy / Sci-Fi Resources and Community for Writers and Fans](https://scifiwriter.ca): Homepage featuring character name generator and writing resources
- [About Us](https://scifiwriter.ca/about): About Dave Stoyles' 2018 site for sci-fi/fantasy writing tools & community
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://scifiwriter.ca/faq): FAQ about SciFiWriter.ca tools, audience, and features for authors

## Writing Resources & Guides

- [Resources](https://scifiwriter.ca/blog): Blog archive with writing tips, character development, and craft articles
- [Scene Checklist for Authors](https://scifiwriter.ca/scene-checklist-for-authors): Comprehensive scene construction checklist for fiction writers
- [NaNoWriMo](https://scifiwriter.ca/nanowrimo): Dave's NaNoWriMo experience, tips, and lessons for 50K-word challenge

## Worldbuilding

- [Alien Plants: Worldbuilding with Extraterrestrial Plant Life](https://scifiwriter.ca/alien-plants): Worldbuilding guide on designing alien flora for speculative fiction
